system.skills: Astral, Athletics, Close Combat, Exotic Ranged Weapon, Perception
system.powers: Astral Form, Concealment, Confusion, Energy Aura (Cold), Guard,
system.description: (Air, Force 4) Boreas have an almost solid, unnaturally blue humanoid form. They wear a fog like cold-weather gear. Every move they make leaves a sublimation trail. Their heads are crowned with a mane and beard of vapors. Boreas are good at tracking and hunting, as they lead a low-tech lifestyle. Their pre- in ferred weapons are spears and nets.
